name: OmaCal
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Omarchy's stock clock and calendar with your calendar laid over it: per-calendar event chips on the month grid, a day view, new events from the panel or a quick-add shortcut, reminders as notifications, the next event in the bar, and time tracking. HEY is the first backend.

barWidget.description: The stock date/time label and calendar popup, with your calendar in it.

schema.label: Today only
schema.description: Show today's current or next event, excluding future reminder windows. Off preserves the original bar behavior. Reminder notifications are unchanged.

schema.label: Event in the bar
schema.description: "soon" shows an event's name and when, from its earliest reminder until it ends. "name" and "time" show only one of the two. "next" always shows today's next event. "off" shows only the calendar glyph.

schema.label: Show HEY reminders as notifications
schema.description: Uses the reminders set on each event in HEY.

schema.label: Quick add shortcut
schema.description: Opens the new-event card from anywhere. Leave empty to turn it off. A shortcut already in use is not taken.

schema.label: Show the calendar icon this many minutes ahead
schema.description: The icon appears this long before an event starts and stays until it ends. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Follow HEY changes live
schema.description: Keeps a `hey watch` running so edits made elsewhere show up within seconds.

schema.label: Hidden calendars
schema.description: Comma-separated calendar names to leave out. Needed on hey-cli 1.3, which cannot see which calendars are switched off in HEY.
